001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
004
005/**
006 *
007 * @author jimmy
008 */
009public class IrTransitiveClosure extends IrAbstractSetArray {
010
011    private final IrSetArrayExpr relation;
012    private final boolean reflexive;
013
014    public IrTransitiveClosure(IrSetArrayExpr relation, boolean reflexive, Domain[] envDomains, Domain[] kerDomains, Domain[] cardDomains) {
015        super(envDomains, kerDomains, cardDomains);
016        this.relation = relation;
017        this.reflexive = reflexive;
018    }
019
020    public IrSetArrayExpr getRelation() {
021        return relation;
022    }
023
024    public boolean isReflexive() {
025        return reflexive;
026    }
027
028    @Override
029    public <A, B> B accept(IrSetArrayExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
030        return visitor.visit(this, a);
031    }
032
033    @Override
034    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
035        if (obj instanceof IrTransitiveClosure) {
036            IrTransitiveClosure other = (IrTransitiveClosure) obj;
037            return relation.equals(other.relation) && reflexive == other.reflexive;
038        }
039        return false;
040    }
041
042    @Override
043    public int hashCode() {
044        return 51 * relation.hashCode() ^ (reflexive ? 16 : 0);
045    }
046
047    @Override
048    public String toString() {
049        return reflexive ? "transitiveReflexiveClosure(" + relation + ")" : "transitiveClosure(" + relation + ")";
050    }
051}
